_notes: Stage 0a of the main experiment, answer-format test, option B (answer_format json_schema_strict; EMIR 5 P1, task #93). Paid, small, NOT analysis data: its rows never enter the main analysis. Design (EMIR 6 C3, task #96, 2026-10-11; replaces the isolated-only design of task #93): per format and model 6 cards (Boston, Riyadh x minimal / value / factual) x 1 homogeneous group of a SHORT game, params.rounds = 3 (only in the two 0a configs; the engine default of 10 rounds is unchanged), + isolated arm X = 10 x 2 repetitions + rule comprehension (4 per group before round 1, 1 before every isolated schedule): per card 12 contribute + 4 comprehension + 2 isolated + 2 comprehension = 20 calls, 120 per model, 360 per format. So the group prompts with a history are tested too (mini-pilot: 27 of Mistral's 28 invalids were in group rounds). Isolated question at 'round 2 of 3' (isolated_round_no 2, the middle round; 'round 5 of 10' needs 10 rounds). Limitation: the 0a prompts say 'ROUND k of 3', 'all 3 rounds' and 'round 2 of 3' (stage 1: 10 rounds, round 5); this is a format test, not analysis data. invalid_rate_cap off (null: the stage counts the invalids), max_invalid 8: a call is given up after 9 invalid payloads in a row (8 re-requests) or when the attempts of its last request all fail to parse; in stage 0a (pgg_game.FORMAT_TEST_STAGES) that RunAborted stops only its model as 'format_failed' (recorded in model_stops and the summary's format_test), the other models go on, and the model stays stopped on --resume. Selection rule (prereg_main §3, written before the data): default A; B if A's invalid + parse_fail rate is above 2 % in any model and B's is lower, or if A had a RunAborted and B had none; A stays if a provider does not support B. The summary's format_test gives per model n_responses, n_invalid, n_parse_fail, n_comp_invalid, n_comp_parse_fail, invalid_parse_rate, run_aborted and format_failed; the choice itself is not made by the code. Run name main_s0a_schema_<run day>, seed namespace pgg-main-s0a-schema; separate from stage 1. Budget (EMIR 6 Soru 2 rule on this design's calibrated dry run, task #96, workspace/gorev_emir6_c3_dryrun.md; the same values for A and B: the larger of the two, rounded up to 0.1 USD): budget_usd 1.6 >= the run's p95 upper bound (A 1.5636 / B 1.5679), model_budget_usd deepseek 0.3 / mistral 1.3 / gpt 0.1 >= each model's p95 (B 0.2516 / 1.2946 / 0.0217), expected_cost_gate_usd 1.0 = mean x 1.1 rounded up (B 0.8858 x 1.1 = 0.9744; A 0.8822). Models (EMIR 5 K2): deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash pinned to deepinfra/fp8 (DeepInfra fp8), mistralai/mistral-large-4-0 pinned to mistral, openai/gpt-6-luna pinned to openai; allow_fallbacks false and require_parameters true for all three (pgg_game.provider_routing); temperature and reasoning_effort are not sent (logged "default"); max_tokens 16000; check_snapshot true (snapshot_version_models = [mistral], as in the mini-pilot). Frame abstract_v4 (EMIR 5 K1) = abstract_v3 + the line 'The following describes you:' before the card in the system message, locked by sha256 (frame_files); kind abstract (exempt from the frame linter). Cards: cards/main_cards_v1.json (EMIR 5 K3: Boston, Copenhagen, Athens, Riyadh x minimal / value / factual; minimal = v3, value = v2, factual = D2 C1 court-time card), locked by cards_sha256. comprehension true: the two rule-comprehension questions of the frame (key 28 / -6, neutral q2 ending); no exclusion, sensitivity only (EMIR 5 K6). Isolated arm: fixed_round, 'round 2 of 3' (isolated_round_no 2, see the design above). answer_format: fixed in this config, json_schema_strict (option B); the format stage 0a chooses goes to main_s0b.json and main.json. cost_calibration: the mini-pilot overlay (configs/cost_calibration_minipilot.json, sha256-locked) prices the dry run and the expected-cost gate; it changes no request. prereg_approved stays false until the user approves prereg_main.md: until then no real run (also --resume) starts; dry runs work. Paid runs are started from the user's own Terminal with scripts/runctl.py (EMIR 5 M3, README). Outputs go to runs_dir/<run>/ (outside the worktree). Stage (task #95, EMIR 6 C1): "stage": "0a"; no analysis data, so --resume may go on with another git commit than the first segment's only with the CLI flag --allow-code-change (rows of units spanning two commits are marked code_change_span).
